name: Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco
program: Annual Call for Projects (climate and renewable energy; water and desertification; biodiversity)
collect_note: Reads the Foundation's English news listing (newest 20 articles) twice a day and keeps announcements of calls for projects, proposals, interest, micro-initiatives and applications (photography award entries and winner news are skipped), reading the closing date from each call's own article; calls wait as candidates because the news also carries ocean and polar calls outside SALSAV's scope. The main annual June call is announced only on the Submit a project page, not in the news.

sample.title: Call for proposals for the Blue Charter Incubator Round II to accelerate ocean action

evidence: channels tried 2026-11-12: endpoint_recon (rss verdict, https://www.fpa2.org/en/feed/actualites, ~40 recent items, no descriptions, no deadlines, so it cannot give dated calls); sitemap.xml 3155 news urls; no WordPress/Drupal/JSON API, no ld+json, no grant portal; submit-a-project is plain HTML with only the June 2026 session text. Chosen: English news listing https://www.fpa2.org/en/actualites (20 articles, article.news_item, h3, a.readmore) with a call-words filter and detail hop. Harness item: Commonwealth Blue Charter Incubator Round II (call announced 2026-10-05), article text 'Applications must be submitted through the online application form by 11 December 2026 at 23:59 GMT' = engine deadline 2026-12-11. Filter also matches the Foundation's earlier titles (2023 call for projects, DIMFE 2025 call for projects, Human-Wildlife 2025 call, BeMed 10th call for micro-initiatives); older ones fall off page 1 (listing is paged, only page 1 is read).
